reason: The STAYS-CLOSED recheck holds under both the VALUE and the FEASIBILITY lens. I verified each premise. (1) In-sample inputs are real. The public detectors were trained on all 199 train videos (CONTEXT l.1071), and so was the edge net (l.1350). Addendum L5: 4 of 5 DaughterNet folds saw the exp60 clips. exp60's split.json excludes only the 20 x138 coord-head stems and 4 dummy twins, so the new lab gives no honest h, p_edge or p_par for add-type mechanisms. This is the edge-filter trap (F-TRN-02: lab +0.01..+0.016, LB 0 on probes 21/29/30). (2) The private break-even was already priced in. v3 mirror private is +0.0005 central (-0.0005..+0.0016), lowdet ~0 (-0.0005..+0.001), edge 0..+0.001 with an uncertain sign. s_merge adjudicated the public 0.265 against the lab ~0.11 and found a loosening lab marginal of 0 TP / +2 FP. The friendlier break-even is outweighed by in-sample precision inflation. (3) Dropping the '0.003 LB noise' premise does not reopen anything. On public, +1 TP = +0.0019, which is below R4's +0.002. Adoption would need >= 2 net TP out of ~1-2.5 reachable public events (~0.4-1.2 evaluable forks). The limit is the small event count, not kernel noise. (4) R8 closes new mechanisms at 27 Sep 12:00. Amendment f2 makes F2 the no-insertion twin, so no private-leaning slot exists for an add. (5) The recommendation to keep the L2 Wilson bar at 0.265 is correct. It also has a reason the finding does not state: the exp60 dumps were downloaded at 20:05 UTC, so lowering a pre-registered gate now would be post-hoc and break R-discipline. Nuance: the public read is biased toward REMOVALS. A removal set whose true precision lies between the private break-even (0.11-0.20) and 0.265 would read positive on public but be negative on private. 'Fine for K3' holds only because forkmid's audit requires 0 TP forks removed (removed-set precision ~0). Feasibility is trivial (no build, no slot, no code). The finding claims no gain and needs no gate.
fix: No build and no reopening. The curator marks I-066/I-067/I-077/I-078 as 're-checked round 2, still closed (in-sample h/p_edge/p_par on exp60, R4 unreachable with ~1-2.5 public events, R8, f2)'. Keep L2 Wilson > 0.265 and n >= 6 unchanged, because it was pre-registered before the exp60 output was read. Add one sentence to the structural note: any fork-REMOVAL rider must keep a 0-TP-removed (or FP >= 3*TP) lab clause, because the public read over-rewards removals whose precision lies between 0.11 and 0.265. Such removals are private-negative.
